messages.subject: Re: Error p.86 of qqplot book
parts:
A simple reply confirmed that the start data used in the intercept argument needs to be changed from a date to a numeric object.  This faithfully reproduces the example in the book.

On Thursday, November 1, 2012 11:53:52 AM UTC-4, Brad Horn wrote:
Here is the code from the book:

(unemp <- qplot(date, unemploy, data=economics, geom="line", 
  xlab = "", ylab = "No. unemployed (1000s)"))

presidential <- presidential[-(1:3), ]

yrng <- range(economics$unemploy)
xrng <- range(economics$date)
unemp + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = start), data = presidential)

When I run the last line above, I do NOT get vertical lines as expected.  Instead I get the following error:

Error: Discrete value supplied to continuous scale

Why?
